product.olivetti-netstrada-7200.summary: The NetStrada documented in use with Linux and an Intel Orion PCI bridge.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7200.history: In February 2001, a NetStrada 7200 user documented their machine on the Linux kernel mailing list and reported running Linux 2.2.18.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7200.architec: The PCI listing for that unit identifies its controllers. It includes Intel 82454KX/GX bridges and an Adaptec AIC-7880U for SCSI.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7200.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7200.limitati: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7200.lkml-own: Pierfrancesco Caci, Linux Kernel Mailing List, 9 February 2001
